title: Grade 8 French — Mon, May 18
description: Passé composé (avoir) — Day 1 of 5: What is it and how is it formed?
subject: french

questions.question: The passé composé is used to describe:
options: Completed actions in the past (I did, I have done)
questions.explanation: Passé composé = compound past tense. Used for completed actions: 'I ate', 'I have eaten', 'I did eat'. Most common past tense in spoken French.

questions.question: Passé composé is formed using:
options: Auxiliary verb (avoir or être) + past participle
questions.explanation: Passé composé = AVOIR/ÊTRE (conjugated in present) + PAST PARTICIPLE. Two components always.

questions.question: Most verbs use which auxiliary in passé composé?
questions.explanation: Most French verbs (including all regular -ER, -IR, -RE verbs) use AVOIR as auxiliary. Only ~17 verbs and reflexive verbs use être.

questions.question: Conjugate AVOIR in present tense for 'j'', 'tu', 'il':
options: je suis / tu es / il est
je fais / tu fais / il fait
questions.explanation: AVOIR: j'ai, tu as, il/elle a, nous avons, vous avez, ils/elles ont. This is the auxiliary for most verbs.

questions.question: Past participle of -ER verbs: PARLER → ?
questions.explanation: Regular -ER verbs: remove -ER, add -É. PARLER → PARLÉ. MANGER → MANGÉ. JOUER → JOUÉ.

questions.question: Form the passé composé: 'J'ai parlé' means:
questions.explanation: 'J'ai parlé' = j'ai (I have) + parlé (spoken) = I spoke / I have spoken. Both English translations are valid.

questions.question: Passé composé of MANGER for 'tu':
questions.explanation: MANGER → past participle MANGÉ. Tu + as (avoir) + mangé = 'Tu as mangé.' = You ate.

questions.question: Passé composé of REGARDER for 'nous':
questions.explanation: REGARDER → REGARDÉ. Nous + avons (avoir) + regardé = 'Nous avons regardé.' = We watched.

questions.question: Passé composé of JOUER for 'ils':
questions.explanation: JOUER → JOUÉ. Ils + ont (avoir for ils) + joué = 'Ils ont joué.' = They played.

questions.question: Translate: 'She watched television.'
questions.explanation: 'Elle a regardé la télévision.' = She watched TV. Elle + a (avoir) + regardé (past participle of regarder).

questions.question: To make passé composé NEGATIVE:
options: Ne before the past participle, pas after
Ne before the auxiliary, pas after the auxiliary (before past participle)
questions.explanation: Negation wraps the AUXILIARY: Je n'ai pas mangé. (ne + auxiliary + pas + past participle). Pas comes between avoir and the past participle.

questions.question: 'Je n'ai pas mangé' means:
options: I didn't eat / I haven't eaten
questions.explanation: 'Je n'ai pas mangé.' = I didn't eat / I have not eaten. ne + ai + pas + mangé (negative wraps the auxiliary).

questions.question: Make negative: 'Nous avons regardé le film.'
options: Nous n'avons pas regardé le film.
Nous ne regardé pas avons le film.
Nous avons ne pas regardé le film.
Nous n'avons regardé pas le film.
questions.explanation: 'Nous n'avons pas regardé le film.' ne wraps avons (auxiliary). Past participle stays after pas.

questions.question: Question form of 'Tu as mangé?':
options: Tu as mangé? (rising intonation — spoken) OR Est-ce que tu as mangé? (formal)
questions.explanation: Question: rising intonation 'Tu as mangé?' (spoken) or 'Est-ce que tu as mangé?' (formal). Both correct. Inversion 'As-tu mangé?' also exists (formal written).

questions.question: Summary: passé composé with avoir formula:
questions.explanation: Formula: Subject + AVOIR conjugated (ai/as/a/avons/avez/ont) + PAST PARTICIPLE. -ER verbs → -É. Two-part structure always.
